name: metry
description: Connect ChatGPT and Codex to Metry through the Metry MCP server.

interface.longDescription:
Say goodbye to manual exports and hello to your energy data, directly in ChatGPT.

Metry is the Nordic energy data platform used by property owners, energy managers, and sustainability teams to collect quality-assured meter data across electricity, heating, cooling, gas, and water - without installing any new hardware.

A selection of things you can do with Metry in ChatGPT:
- Analyse energy trends and spot anomalies across your portfolio
- Compare monthly consumption between buildings or assets
- Navigate your organisation structure - from regions down to individual spaces
- Pull hourly, daily, or monthly consumption series for any period
- Answer sustainability reporting questions without leaving your workflow
